# Shared x402 Core cases

`core.json` contains the complete `x402-core` suite from `inflow-specs/fixtures/x402.mjs`
at revision `f20033742244dc4220e0cdc05db1e1eeeaccdb63`.

The tests execute exported SDK helpers and compare their results to the shared expectations.
These cases do not perform payments or certify Buyer/Seller lifecycle behavior.
